attribution: Reserve Bank of India, House Price Index (quarterly, transaction data from state registration authorities; bases 2008-09, 2010-11 and 2022-23 linked on the RBI's own overlaps), Database on Indian Economy (data.rbi.org.in).
basis: RBI House Price Index of registered residential transactions (2022-23 = 100, older bases linked on the RBI's published overlaps), quarterly
name: Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida)
notes: Gautam Buddha Nagar: Reserve Bank of India House Price Index of registered residential transactions, quarterly, 2022 Q2 to 2026 Q2 (17 quarters), 2022-23 = 100. Older RBI bases (2010-11, 2008-09) are linked onto the 2022-23 base on the quarters in which the RBI publishes both. Only the 2022-23 base covers this city, so the history is short. All India is the RBI's population-weighted average of the city indices. The latest two quarters are provisional.
